llms.body:
# Linktree

> Linktree gives creators, businesses and anyone building online one place to bring
everything together, reach their audience directly, and turn attention into real
opportunity. Link in bio is one feature inside the platform, not the whole of it.
Trusted by 70M+ brands and creators. This file lists publicly indexable,
logged-out pages of https://linktr.ee/ that describe the product, pricing,
marketplace, help content and company information. Individual profiles at
https://linktr.ee/{username} are not enumerated here; see the sitemaps
referenced in /robots.txt for the full crawlable surface.

Core entity data

- Company: Linktree Pty Ltd (ABN 68 608 721 562)
- Platform: Linktree
- Canonical URL: https://linktr.ee/
- Founded: 2016
- Headquarters: 1-9 Sackville St, Collingwood, Victoria 3066, Australia
- Category: growth platform for creators and small businesses
- Capabilities: link in bio, custom design and themes, built-in analytics,
digital product sales, booking and scheduling, email capture, affiliate
storefront, online courses, social media scheduling
- Primary audiences: creators, solopreneurs and small businesses — including
musicians, podcasters, real estate agents, fitness coaches, food creators and
YouTubers — plus agencies and talent managers

Plans are Free, Starter, Pro and Premium, plus custom Agency and Enterprise plans.
The free plan already includes unlimited basic links, selling products and courses,
and earning from brand offers. Current plans and feature coverage are on the
[pricing page](https://linktr.ee/s/pricing).

Notes for agents:

- Profile pages (`https://linktr.ee/{username}`) are public, server-rendered HTML
and are not listed here. They are discoverable via the sitemaps in `/robots.txt`.
- Every URL in this file returns 200 directly, with no redirect hop.
- The blog is published at `https://linktr.ee/blog`, with categories under
`https://linktr.ee/blogs/categories/`.
- The Marketplace lists third-party apps and integrations.
- See also: https://linktr.ee/robots.txt and the sitemaps listed within it.

## Product

- [Home](https://linktr.ee/): What Linktree is and who it is for.
- [Pricing](https://linktr.ee/s/pricing): Free, Starter, Pro and Premium plan tiers, with monthly and annual billing.
- [All features](https://linktr.ee/features): Index of what the platform does.
- [All Linktree features: formatted for AI agents](https://linktr.ee/features.md): The /features taxonomy as markdown for AI agents.
- [Link in bio](https://linktr.ee/features/link-in-bio): For anyone building online who wants one always-current destination for their audience, without updating links every time something changes.
- [Analytics](https://linktr.ee/features/analytics): Track link performance and traffic sources, and see which platforms drive growth.
- [Audience manager](https://linktr.ee/features/audience-management): Collect and organize leads in one place, and sync them to your email tools.
- [QR code generator](https://linktr.ee/features/qr-code-generator): Create a custom QR code that points to your Linktree, for print and in-person use.
- [Link shortener](https://linktr.ee/features/link-shortener): Create short, shareable URLs and track clicks on links you share elsewhere.
- [Shops](https://linktr.ee/features/shops): Earn affiliate commissions from products you recommend, with no ecommerce setup.
- [Digital products](https://linktr.ee/features/digital-products): Sell ebooks, templates, presets and tracks directly from your Linktree.
- [Courses](https://linktr.ee/features/courses): Create and sell an online course from your Linktree.
- [Sponsored links](https://linktr.ee/features/sponsored-links): Get paid when your audience redeems a brand offer, with deals browsable in the Earn tab.
- [Bookings](https://linktr.ee/features/bookings): Offer free and paid bookings so people can book time with you directly.
- [Bookings on Linktree: formatted for AI agents](https://linktr.ee/features/bookings.md): The /features/bookings page as markdown for AI agents.
- [Contact forms](https://linktr.ee/features/contact-forms): Add a branded form to collect emails, enquiries and leads.
- [Email integrations](https://linktr.ee/features/email-integrations): Sync subscribers automatically to Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Kit, Beehiiv or Google Sheets.
- [Instagram auto-reply](https://linktr.ee/features/instagram-auto-reply): Set up automatic replies to Instagram comments and DMs.
- [Social planner](https://linktr.ee/features/social-planner): Plan, schedule and auto-post across your social platforms from one place.
- [AI caption generator](https://linktr.ee/features/ai-caption-generator): Draft captions and social content with AI.
- [Hashtag generator](https://linktr.ee/features/hashtag-generator): Generate hashtags for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn.
- [Canva integration](https://linktr.ee/features/canva-integration): Browse and apply your Canva designs from inside the Linktree editor.
- [Rewards](https://linktr.ee/features/rewards): Earn points and cash bonuses for building your Linktree.
- [Templates](https://linktr.ee/s/templates): Ready-made Linktree layouts you can customize.

## Who it is for

- [Musicians](https://linktr.ee/for/musicians): How musicians share music, sell tickets and merch, and connect with fans.
- [Podcasters](https://linktr.ee/for/podcasts): How podcasters point listeners to every episode and listening platform.
- [Small business](https://linktr.ee/for/small-business): How small businesses turn followers into customers.
- [Ecommerce](https://linktr.ee/for/ecommerce): How online sellers drive traffic and sales from social profiles.
- [Real estate agents](https://linktr.ee/for/real-estate-agents): How agents share listings, capture leads and keep properties current.
- [Enterprise](https://linktr.ee/s/about/enterprise): Linktree for larger organizations and teams.

## Marketplace

- [Marketplace](https://linktr.ee/marketplace): Directory of apps and integrations that extend Linktree profiles.
- [Browse all](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/browse): Full index of available Link Apps and integrations.
- [Share content apps](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/categories/share-content): Apps for sharing music, video and social content.
- [Make money apps](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/categories/make-money): Apps for selling products, fundraising and monetization.
- [Grow following apps](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/categories/grow-following): Apps for audience growth and contact capture.
- [Developer program](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/developer): Information for developers building on the Linktree platform.

## Learn

- [Blog](https://linktr.ee/blog): Articles on the creator economy, best practices, product news and success stories.
- [Product News](https://linktr.ee/blogs/categories/product-news): Announcements of new Linktree features.
- [Success Stories](https://linktr.ee/blogs/categories/success-stories): Case studies of creators and brands using Linktree.
- [Help Center](https://linktr.ee/help): Support articles, how-tos and troubleshooting.

## Company

- [About](https://linktr.ee/s/about): About Linktree the company, and the founders' story.
- [Careers](https://linktr.ee/s/about/careers): Open roles at Linktree.
- [Press](https://linktr.ee/s/about/press): Press releases and media resources.
- [Contact](https://linktr.ee/s/about/contact): Contact information.

## Legal

- [Terms and Conditions](https://linktr.ee/s/terms): Terms of service for linktr.ee.
- [Privacy Notice](https://linktr.ee/s/privacy): How Linktree collects and uses personal information.
- [Cookie Notice](https://linktr.ee/s/about/cookie-notice): Cookie and tracking-technology disclosures.

## Optional

- [Sitemap index (profile directory)](https://linktr.ee/discover/profile-directory/sitemapindex.xml): Index of crawlable public profiles.
- [Marketing sitemap](https://linktr.ee/s/wf/sitemap.xml): Sitemap for marketing and content pages.
- [Marketplace sitemap](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/sitemap.xml): Sitemap for marketplace apps and integrations.
- [Templates sitemap](https://linktr.ee/s/templates/sitemap.xml): Sitemap for Linktree templates and template categories.
- [Help Center sitemap](https://linktr.ee/help/sitemap.xml): Sitemap for Help Center articles and collections.
- [Robots.txt](https://linktr.ee/robots.txt): Crawler access policy and full list of sitemaps.

Questions? Answered

Is Linktree the original link in bio tool?
The short answer? Yes!

Back in 2016, we created Linktree as an easy way to link out to all socials and unify digital ecosystems, pioneering the link-in-bio category. Linktree remains the leading, biggest and most popular link-in-bio solution – but that’s just the beginning. You can use your Linktree URL or QR code anywhere your audience is, including on your business cards, in your email signature, on paper-based posters and brochures, and even on your resumé. If you don’t have a website, that’s fine. If you have a Linktree, you don’t need one!
Can you get paid and sell things from a Linktree?
Yes, you can! We offer plenty of ways to sell products and monetize your audience. You can collect revenue from affiliate links, and sell your products right in your Linktree. Monetisation features are only available for selected countries, see this Help Article for more.

A lot of Linktree creators see incredible results with online sales on Linktree, because it removes the extra steps involved in a purchase.

“We love how Linktree has helped us manage our business by having all social media and ways to pay in one location. The QR code has made it easy for customers to access it all!” – Tiffany
Is Linktree safe to use on all of my social media profiles?
Linktree is trusted by all social platforms, and is even used on many of Facebook, Instagram and TikTok’s own social media accounts! Because Linktree is the original and most popular link-in-bio tool, the linktr.ee URL is a trusted, identifiable and familiar link that audiences feel comfy and safe clicking on.
What makes Linktree better than the other link in bio options?
We have our own opinions here, of course, but the stories of the people who use Linktree matter more. Let’s hear what they have to say:

“Four months into creating, someone messaged me like: You need a Linktree. I can’t remember what I was using at the time, but it was one of those ones that were supposed to be easy. Once I got Linktree set up, I was like, oh my god – why did I spend $100 on a website? I don’t need all of that! Now, I can see the monetization of my following becoming a full-time thing.” – David Coleman

It’s so much easier to set up and have all of your links in one place in a well designed format.” – Catie T

“Websites are cool (I have one) but Linktrees just make it so much easier.” – Tan Nguyen

“I love their analytics. Other link-in-bio companies don’t provide extensive data on what’s going on.” – Riley Lemon

Linktree invented the bio link tool in 2016, and it continues to be the world’s most popular bio link to this day – with 50M+ people using it as their trusted place to share, sell and grow online. Join them on Linktree today and see for yourself!
How can I drive more traffic to and through my Linktree?
Sharing your Linktree on every social platform you have makes it easy for your most important content to be seen and engaged with by all of your followers. You can even use QR codes to generate online traffic in offline places, and drive people to your links.

Once visitors arrive on your Linktree, easy-to-understand analytics help you quickly and easily discover where they’re coming from, and what they’re clicking on. You can immediately see what’s working and what’s not and improve your Linktree on the fly with different link placement, prioritized links, subheadings, animation and more to make sure your traffic is landing exactly where you want it!
How many links should I have on my Linktree?
This depends on two things. If your priority is click-throughs and conversion, we recommend having 3-7 links on your Linktree at once (based on our most successful creators). Including too many options for your visitors slows down their course of action.

That said: for certain creators whose priority is display, education and showcasing (e.g. a record label with a library of new releases to promote, or a management company looking to showcase their full roster of clients), including more than seven links fulfils their purpose perfectly.

You can use features on Linktree to add subheadings, sections, animation and other prioritisation methods to your links – so no matter how many things you’ve got to share, you can drive your visitors to what’s most important, first.
Do I need a website to use Linktree?
No, you don’t! Linktree can act as your very own mini-website to share, sell and grow without any of the time and effort it takes to build and maintain a regular website. You can create a design that fully reflects your personality and brand in seconds, with no knowledge, skills or experience needed. If you already have a website, that’s great: you can add it to your Linktree.

“I hardly touch my website any more. I just send people to my Linktree! It’s a good-looking, fresh interface… so much more dynamic. I can take a few minutes, update my links and put my phone away rather than spending 45 struggling on WordPress.” – @ashleyhopeperez
Where can I download the app?
Find it in the App Store, and in the Google Play store!
